svg.title: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra — silver
svg.desc: Original front-view vector illustration, MIT (LICENSE.txt). Manufacturer specifications are references for measurements and product details, not sources of artwork. Portrait, 10 units/mm. Body 208.5 × 326.3 mm; centered display derived from 369.9 mm full-rectangle diagonal and 1848 × 2960 pixels. Original illustration: placement, corner radii, camera details and finish swatches are approximations. Long-edge cutout and lens use body coordinates; rotate both with the frame. Sources: https://news.samsung.com/global/meet-samsung-galaxy-tab-s11-series-packing-everything-you-expect-from-a-premium-tablet; https://www.samsung.com/uk/tablets/galaxy-tab-s/galaxy-tab-s11-ultra-grey-256gb-wi-fi-sm-x930nzareub/
